cases.sentence: Когда приблизился ___ Давида, он дал своему сыну Соломону наставление.
cases.explain: «смертный час» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now the days of David came near that he should die; and he commanded Solomon his son, saying,

cases.sentence: Он осыпал меня ___ в день, когда я шел в Маханаим.
cases.explain: «страшными проклятиями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by Yahweh, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’

cases.sentence: Ты ___, ты поймешь, что с ним сделать.
cases.explain: «мудрый человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now therefore don’t hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you shall bring his gray head down to Sheol with blood.”

cases.sentence: — Ты знаешь, — сказал он, — что царство было моим, и на меня смотрел весь Израиль как на ___.
cases.explain: «будущего царя» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He said, “You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign. However the kingdom is turned around, and has become my brother’s; for it was his from Yahweh.

cases.sentence: — У меня к тебе ___, — сказала она.
cases.explain: «маленькая просьба» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Then she said, “I ask one small petition of you; don’t deny me.” The king said to her, “Ask on, my mother; for I will not deny you.”

cases.sentence: Но на Давиде и его семя, его доме и престоле пусть вечно будет ___.
cases.explain: «Господень мир» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: So their blood will return on the head of Joab, and on the head of his offspring forever. But for David, for his offspring, for his house, and for his throne, there will be peace forever from Yahweh.”
